accepted_parent.scope: one aircraft, three two-hour fixed missions at h8-10/h20-22/h32-34, DAMP=0, DAMRT=3000000 per million mission hours, no ordinary failures, zero-probability attrition consequence, seed1

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp437-439 says only one of MissionDamage.DAMP and DAMRT may be greater than zero for a mission type, damage type and system, and only one field may be used at a time.
source_delta: The control is byte-identical to the accepted H01.var02 rate source. The child changes only MissionDamage.DAMP from 0 to 1 and ProblemDescription. DAMRT stays 3000000; all missions, seed, consequence probability, system and horizon are identical.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: The native control should convert with zero errors and reproduce the accepted fixed-seed rate events and 72-bin reports.
pre_run_hypotheses.simultaneous: The native converter should reject simultaneous positive DAMP and DAMRT with a relevant error before simulation. Import/export should still exactly roundtrip all 16 authored row-containing tables. No child event or report is required after rejection.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Acceptance of both positive fields, a different converter error unrelated to their exclusivity, mismatched roundtrip, or incomplete control is diagnostic only. A successful process exit alone is not acceptance.

acceptance_gates: Independent static review of frozen source, exact diff, installed manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner before native execution
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact 16/16 authored row-containing table roundtrips, zero control converter errors and a relevant simultaneous-fields child converter rejection
Valid control event/report reconciliation, child rejection without valid simulated result, SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: The claim concerns this installed converter and these exact positive values/model only; it does not establish other versions or every invalid input combination.
A rejected child yields no damage behavior claim. Intermediate DAMP, other rates/consequences, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain untested.
